INSERT INTO ast_product_official_info (product_code, product_model, product_name, product_desc, technical_spec, product_category, product_type, list_price, crm_status, business_unit, product_line, org_id, source_created_at, source_updated_at, crm_state_code, crm_status_code, product_stage, end_of_sale_date, end_of_support_date, end_of_life_date, last_renewal_date, id, tenant_id, source_system, source_key, source_version, status, version, synced_at, creator, updater, create_time, update_time, deleted, sync_status) VALUES
(#{row.productCode}, #{row.productModel}, #{row.productName}, #{row.productDesc}, #{row.technicalSpec}, #{row.productCategory}, #{row.productType}, #{row.listPrice}, #{row.crmStatus}, #{row.businessUnit}, #{row.productLine}, #{row.orgId}, #{row.sourceCreatedAt}, #{row.sourceUpdatedAt}, #{row.crmStateCode}, #{row.crmStatusCode}, #{row.productStage}, #{row.endOfSaleDate}, #{row.endOfSupportDate}, #{row.endOfLifeDate}, #{row.lastRenewalDate}, #{row.id}, #{context.tenantId}, 'CRM', #{row.productCode}, #{row.sourceVersion}, CASE WHEN #{row.crmStateCode}=0 THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END, 0, #{context.startedAt}, #{context.actorId}, #{context.actorId}, #{context.startedAt}, #{context.startedAt}, FALSE, 'SUCCESS')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
id=CASE WHEN ast_product_official_info.tenant_id=VALUES(tenant_id) AND CAST(ast_product_official_info.product_code AS BINARY)=CAST(VALUES(product_code) AS BINARY) AND ast_product_official_info.deleted=FALSE AND CAST(ast_product_official_info.source_system AS BINARY) IN (CAST('CRM' AS BINARY),CAST('DPPMS' AS BINARY)) THEN ast_product_official_info.id ELSE NULL END, product_model=COALESCE(VALUES(product_model),ast_product_official_info.product_model), product_name=COALESCE(VALUES(product_name),ast_product_official_info.product_name), product_desc=COALESCE(VALUES(product_desc),ast_product_official_info.product_desc), technical_spec=COALESCE(VALUES(technical_spec),ast_product_official_info.technical_spec), product_category=COALESCE(VALUES(product_category),ast_product_official_info.product_category), product_type=COALESCE(VALUES(product_type),ast_product_official_info.product_type), list_price=COALESCE(VALUES(list_price),ast_product_official_info.list_price), crm_status=COALESCE(VALUES(crm_status),ast_product_official_info.crm_status), business_unit=COALESCE(VALUES(business_unit),ast_product_official_info.business_unit), product_line=COALESCE(VALUES(product_line),ast_product_official_info.product_line), org_id=COALESCE(VALUES(org_id),ast_product_official_info.org_id), source_created_at=COALESCE(VALUES(source_created_at),ast_product_official_info.source_created_at), source_updated_at=COALESCE(VALUES(source_updated_at),ast_product_official_info.source_updated_at), crm_state_code=COALESCE(VALUES(crm_state_code),ast_product_official_info.crm_state_code), crm_status_code=COALESCE(VALUES(crm_status_code),ast_product_official_info.crm_status_code), product_stage=COALESCE(VALUES(product_stage),ast_product_official_info.product_stage), end_of_sale_date=COALESCE(VALUES(end_of_sale_date),ast_product_official_info.end_of_sale_date), end_of_support_date=COALESCE(VALUES(end_of_support_date),ast_product_official_info.end_of_support_date), end_of_life_date=COALESCE(VALUES(end_of_life_date),ast_product_official_info.end_of_life_date), last_renewal_date=COALESCE(VALUES(last_renewal_date),ast_product_official_info.last_renewal_date), source_system=VALUES(source_system), source_key=VALUES(source_key), source_version=VALUES(source_version), status=VALUES(status), synced_at=VALUES(synced_at), updater=VALUES(updater), update_time=VALUES(update_time), sync_status=VALUES(sync_status), version=ast_product_official_info.version+1
